content:
You can find information about current development priorities on the Thunderbird for Android roadmap.

On your specific question, maintainers have provided feedback on a few github tickets.

June 2026 https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/pull/11033#issuecomment-4771201103

We have had several discussions about encryption (GPG and S/MIME) in the app. This isn't in our roadmap for 2026, though might be something we add to 2027. For now we are prioritizing PRs that align with our 2026 roadmap.

Apr 2026 https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues/6085#issuecomment-4246727501

I believe right now OpenKeychain still works despite lower maintenance, so for the time being we're focusing on core stability. I totally understand the importance of this issue. When the urgency is higher we'll evaluate options as noted and seek out a solution.

https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues/6085#issuecomment-4224692256

Implementing PGP/GPG directly in Thunderbird is a significant undertaking, and unfortunately, we currently do not have the resources to manage it. As @kewisch mentioned, we are keeping an eye on the situation. If there is a need, we will evaluate how we might proceed with this.
